title: coelogyne crocea
intro: Coelogyne crocea, commonly known as the Golden Coelogyne, is a species of orchid. This plant is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family, characterized by its golden-yellow flowers and robust growth. The health benefits of Coelogyne crocea include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne crocea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
